message.reasoning:
DAG: C→T, C→Y, I→T, T→Y, T→M, M→Y, T→Z, Y→Z.

Total effect of T on Y. Backdoor paths: T←C→Y (open, need C). T←I? I only points to T, so I is not a cause of anything else — no backdoor via I. T→M→Y is a causal path (part of total effect), must not block. T→Z←Y is a collider path, not open unless conditioned on Z.

Minimal adjustment set: {C}. I is not needed (no backdoor). M is mediator, Z is collider.

Conditioning on M: blocks mediated path, leaving direct effect T→Y (but C still conditioned). So "direct".

Z is collider: true.

Conditioning on Z: opens collider path T→Z←Y, introducing bias. "introduces_bias".

I is instrument: I→T, I affects Y only through T, no confounding between I and Y? I has no parents, no other causes. I→T→Y, I→T←C→Y — I is associated with C? No, I and C are independent (no common cause). So I is a valid instrument: true.
